corrected_json.statement_latex: Definition 5.1 A Hamiltonian system is said to be ergodic on an energy surface $\Sigma_E$ (microcanonically ergodic) if, for almost all trajectories $\Gamma$ emanating from initial conditions on $\Sigma_E$, and for any observable $g$, the following holds $\bar g_\Gamma=\operatorname{Av}_{H=E}(g)$, where $\bar g_\Gamma$ is defined in (5.9). By “almost all” we mean that there could be a low-dimensional subset for which the trajectory averages fail to equal the space averages.
